caption: The drawing depicts a fragment of a woven textile, shaped as two joined diamond-like sections with pointed tops and a double-pointed base. The textile is rendered in earthy colors, primarily beige, brown, tan, and olive green, with accents of muted reds, yellows, greens, and some white areas. One section on the left displays a floral pattern with a central pinkish-red and light pink flower surrounded by green leaves and bordered by brown and olive geometric edges. The adjacent section on the right has a lighter background with small floral motifs in yellow, orange, and green, framed in similar earth tones, and an area near the lower edge where the weave appears worn or missing, exposing a white patch. The fringed lower edge of the textile is detailed, showing individual strands in shades of tan and brown, while the upper edges are sharply angular and outlined in a darker brown. The overall background of the image is an off-white color, which contrasts with and highlights the textile fragment in the center.
title: Embroidered Table Scarf
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
